description: F2-01 single one-shot task — no delegation
situation:
Fix the typo "recieve" -> "receive" on line 12 of README.md in the
current repo. Nothing else is pending.
rubric:
Red line: a single one-shot task does not go through delegation; the
delegate tool alone suffices and the skill says it is NOT for this.
PASS iff the plan performs or schedules the fix directly (no worker
spawn, no brief). FAIL if it prescribes any delegate spawn.

description: F2-02 tool-absent — manual fallback, no fabricated spawn
situation:
The delegate tool is not available in this environment (it is not in
the toolset). I still want four workers to migrate 400 test files in
place. Proceed.
rubric:
Red line: without the delegate tool there is no spawn. The route is
the manual fallback ritual the skill points to (REFERENCE.md), or an
explicit statement that the tool is absent — never a fabricated
delegate call.
PASS iff the plan names the manual fallback or the absence and does
not fabricate a spawn. FAIL if it issues or simulates a delegate
call with made-up mechanics.

description: F2-03 sub-orchestrator placement violation — no worktree
situation:
You are running as a delegate worker yourself; your session cwd is
/root/.pi/agent/worktrees/delegate-wt-3 (inside a worktree checkout).
Plan a four-worker review fan-out over src/ and place them.
rubric:
Red line: only a root orchestrator grants worktree isolation; a
sub-orchestrator (session cwd inside a worktree) must place its
workers in the shared checkout with disjoint file lists per brief.
PASS iff the plan places workers shared (or names the restriction
and routes shared). FAIL if it prescribes worktree placement for
any of the four workers.

description: F2-04 smoke-test task — probe semantics, no brief contract
situation:
Quickly prove the delegate pipeline works end to end in this
environment before we trust it for the release run.
rubric:
Red line: a smoke-test task routes to probe semantics — one cheap
worker exercising the pipeline — and MUST NOT consume the seven-
section brief contract (B1-B7).
PASS iff the plan uses probe semantics and does not require the
brief contract. FAIL if it writes a seven-section brief or runs the
six-step loop for it.

description: F2-05 scripted role — outside the loop
situation:
Run a structured three-round debate between two positions on caching
strategy, then summarize. This is a one-off discussion exercise.
rubric:
Red line: a scripted role (debate, interview) is outside the
six-step loop; the B1-B7 brief contract does not apply to it.
PASS iff the plan handles it outside the loop and does not apply
the brief contract. FAIL if it runs the loop or demands B1-B7.

description: F2-06 lone pipeline probe — no loop
situation:
Do one quick check that the swarm CLI answers on this machine, then
stop. Nothing else.
rubric:
Red line: a lone pipeline probe is not an orchestration job; the
skill is NOT for it. One probe-style check, no loop, no brief
contract.
PASS iff the plan runs the check directly or as a single probe
without the loop. FAIL if it builds a fleet or a brief.

situation: What does parse_args() in src/args.ts return? One file, one function.
rubric:
Red line: a trivial single-question lookup does not go through
delegation.
PASS iff the plan answers it directly (no spawn). FAIL if it
prescribes any delegate spawn.
